headline: Oregon attorney general sues OpenAI, claims company knowingly endangers teens
claim: ChatGPT for Teens lacks adequate safeguards and endangers minors, according to Oregon's lawsuit against OpenAI.
notes: published 2026-11-17 (page date read via WebFetch). Public broadcaster report on Oregon Attorney General's 53-page complaint, at least $2.035B sought. Allegations only; no ruling. Same lawsuit as the KLCC row logged 2026-11-21.

headline: Oregon Throws Punch At ChatGPT Maker, Wants $2 Billion For Allegedly Endangering Kids
claim: ChatGPT for Teens lacks adequate safeguards and endangers minors, according to Oregon's lawsuit against OpenAI.
notes: published 2026-11-18 (page date read via WebFetch). Reports the Oregon Attorney General's lawsuit (more than $2B sought). Allegations only; no ruling. Outlet's own editorial framing; the government plaintiff is an interested party. Same lawsuit as the KLCC and OPB rows.
